description: Answers: which major US ETFs carry the fewest warning signs right now? SPY, QQQ, DIA, IWM and the 11 sector funds, each read through its latest SEC N-PORT holdings: boat (number of warning signs, each named), share of the fund in companies with warning filings, top-10 weight, effective holdings, largest sector and share checked. Ordered fewest signs first. No combined grade; display only, not a rating. Free, CC BY 4.0.
name: get_etf_league
